# Mineral Wool Insulation

> TUNGKIN INDUSTRY's leading manufacturer of stonewool and mineral wool insulation products for thermal and acoustic applications.

This is the official website of TUNGKIN INDUSTRY, a China-based factory specializing in high-quality stonewool insulation boards, blankets, and related mineral wool products. The site serves a global audience with multilingual content across 16+ languages.
